contexts.text: What is determinate to persons, in the internal sense, falls into an idea which is indeterminate to anyone.
By which is signified, that nothing must be indeterminate; for that which is indeterminate is open...
It is thus an indeterminate and universal something, which signifies nothing.
Without the Lord's love... not only would each and all things be indeterminate, but they would be nothing at all.
In the Spiritual World an indeterminate idea about God is no idea about Him...
Many, when thinking about God the Father, have an indeterminate idea; and these easily acknowledge nature as god... Lest they should become insane through their indeterminate idea concerning God...
